import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from polisyos.core.artifacts import ArtifactRef,FileSystemCAS
from polisyos.scientist.methods.search.sensitivity_adapter import SensitivityAwareCandidateGenerator
class Base:
 def generate(self,history,current_best,context):return {"x":0.5}
store=FileSystemCAS(Path(sys.argv[1]))
ref=ArtifactRef.model_validate(json.loads(sys.argv[2]))
reader=SensitivityAwareCandidateGenerator.from_artifact(Base(),store,ref)
metadata=reader.generate([],None,{})["_sensitivity"]
assert metadata["ranking"]==["x","z"]
assert metadata["population_law_status"]=="not_established"
assert metadata["analysis_ref"]==ref.model_dump(mode="json")
print(json.dumps({"consumer":"SensitivityAwareCandidateGenerator.from_artifact","metadata":metadata,"fresh_process":True},sort_keys=True))
